message.content: {"quality": false, "reason": "The candidate proposes using phrase grounding to resolve left vs. right scoliosis on a lateral chest X-ray (marked 'LT LAT'). Phrase grounding cannot recover lost lateralization information from a single lateral projection. The source trajectory confirms this limitation (expert notes definitive lateralization requires a frontal view), yet the candidate ignores this constraint and mandates a tool call that cannot succeed.
